capabilities: Pair a vault with a Ling account via obsidian://ling-sync and scoped consent
Upload selected Markdown folders to Ling with cursor-based manifests and change batches
Apply agent-requested create, replace, move, and trash commands inside approved folders
Reconcile vault and server state after startup, resume, or sync conflicts
Store connector tokens in Obsidian SecretStorage and keep connection state vault-local
extras: Beta integration, not yet a published Obsidian Community Plugin listing; requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or newer for SecretStorage; only one connector device per Ling account and vault, and API base URL and folders are locked while connected.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to mirror selected Markdown notes to the Ling app or to accept note changes requested by Ling's agent.

relations.evidence: sends selected Markdown notes to Ling through the provider-neutral Notes Integration API

summary: Syncs selected Markdown notes from an Obsidian vault to the Ling app through its Notes Integration API, with agent-requested writes back into approved folders.
